thread:
Priya: Hi team — saw the DPA addendum in the portal. Two quick asks: can Redwood confirm KMS key provenance for our BYOK flow, and clarify embeddings retention policy for our tenant? Need answers for our legal review tomorrow. Thanks!

Maya (CS): Thanks @Priya — looping in Alex from security and Jamie from legal. Quick Q: do you need an attestation doc or just the proof-of-keys export?

Priya: Attestation preferred, but proof + short statement is fine if we can get it today.

Maya (CS): Alex — can you share the KMS provenance doc and a 1-paragraph blurb we can drop into the addendum? Also we need a clear line for embeddings retention: what's the default and what controls exist for customers?

Alex (Security): On it. We'll produce a key-provenance PDF + a 1-paragraph attestation. We will redact internal operator IDs. Quick facts: we support customer BYOK with KMS provenance exported; default embeddings retention is 30 days for raw vectors and 365 days for derived/aggregated artifacts unless customer opts into shorter retention. We don't store raw prompts tied to embeddings by default. Uploading evidence now to the secure bucket: `s3://redwood-sec-evidence/dpa/1768888888_kms_provenance.pdf`

Jamie (Legal): For the addendum language: suggest we add a short BYOK clause + two sentences about exportability of key provenance and redaction. I'll draft minor edits to the addendum and share. If DeltaHealth needs signed attestation, we can append the attestation page.

Maya (CS): Thanks. Priya — would a 30-minute call at 4pm PT work to walk through the docs and the clause? If not, I'll drop the artifacts and a one-page runbook here.

Priya: 4pm PT works for us. Also can you include SSO/audit log extracts for our tenant for the last 90 days? Legal wants evidence of access control and rotations.

OpsBot: Evidence upload started by @Alex. Artifact: https://evidence.redwood.com/artifacts/1768888888 (expires in 7 days) :package:

Alex (Security): Uploaded audit extract as `audit_extract_90d.csv.gz` to the same bucket and added a README with field descriptions. Also attaching short attestation snippet you can paste into the addendum:

```
Redwood Inference attests that the customer-managed key were provisioned via the documented BYOK flow, key provenance exported on 2026-03-23, and no plaintext key material is stored in Redwood systems. Redactions applied to operator identifiers as required for internal security.
```

Maya (CS): Perfect. Jamie — once you update language I'll combine with Alex's attestation and the logs and send back to Priya + DeltaHealth legal for signature. Will also include a 1-page runbook: how to request key rotation, where to fetch provenance, and retention settings.

Jamie (Legal): Drafting now, will post in thread in ~30m.

Maya (CS): Great — I'll prep the meeting invite and share the artifacts here before the call. :thumbsup:

Priya: Appreciated, team. See you at 4.
